# Carolina Barbecue

> A structured directory of barbecue in North and South Carolina: styles, sauces, dishes, pit practice, places, people, organizations, events and vocabulary. One JSON record per node; every field carries a provenance tier (cited / harvested / tradition / inference / field); records say what their neighbours are to them in both directions.

Records are CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Place points are OpenStreetMap, ODbL 1.0 (share-alike). Pictures carry their own licences, stated per file. Scope and gaps: https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/api/coverage.json

## Styles
- [Eastern North Carolina barbecue](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/style/eastern-nc/): The whole pig, split and cooked over coals or on a gas or electric cooker, then chopped — skin, ham, shoulder, loin and belly together, 'every part of the hog except the squeal' — and dressed after cooking with a thin…
- [Heavy tomato barbecue](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/style/sc-heavy-tomato/): Pork shoulders and butts, ribs and chicken cooked over hickory or on cookers and served with a thick, sweet, red sauce of tomato, brown sugar or molasses, vinegar and spices — the sauce the state tourism office says you…
- [Lexington-style barbecue](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/style/lexington/): Pork shoulders cooked slowly over hardwood coals, usually hickory, then chopped, coarse-chopped or sliced and dressed with a thin red sauce the Piedmont calls dip: vinegar, ketchup or tomato, water, salt, pepper and red…
- [Light tomato barbecue](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/style/sc-light-tomato/): Pork — whole hog in the Pee Dee, shoulders and hams in the upper Midlands — cooked over coals or on cookers and served with a thin sauce that is the Carolinas' vinegar-and-pepper with ketchup stirred in.
- [Pee Dee whole-hog barbecue](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/style/sc-pee-dee/): Whole hogs cooked overnight over hardwood coals, pulled or chopped, and dressed with a thin sauce of vinegar, salt, black pepper and red pepper — the same sauce as eastern North Carolina's across the state line.
- [South Carolina mustard barbecue](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/style/sc-mustard/): Pork — whole hogs at some pits, hams or shoulders at others — cooked over hardwood coals or on cookers, chopped or pulled, and dressed with a yellow sauce of prepared mustard, vinegar, sugar and spices.

## Sauces
- [Bone Suckin' Sauce](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/sauce/bone-suckin-sauce/): A Raleigh line of bottled sauces, of which the one that built the brand is Sweet Southern: cane sugar first, tomato puree second, water third, apple cider vinegar fourth, at six grams of sugar to the tablespoon.
- [Carolina Treet](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/sauce/carolina-treet/): A Wilmington sauce that fits none of the four Carolina bases. Its label reads water, vinegar, wheat flour, salt, soybean oil, paprika, garlic, onion, xanthan gum, spices — no tomato, no mustard, no sugar.
- [George's Barbecue Sauce](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/sauce/georges-barbecue-sauce/): A bottled sauce from Nashville, North Carolina, a Nash County town on the edge of the Coastal Plain, sold in three strengths: Original, Hot and Special.
- [Golding Farms Foods](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/sauce/golding-farms-sauces/): A Winston-Salem sauce manufacturer, the second of that city's two, and one whose output mostly reaches a table under someone else's name.
- [heavy tomato sauce](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/sauce/heavy-tomato-sauce/): A thick red sauce built on tomato — ketchup, paste or sauce — sweetened with brown sugar or molasses, soured with vinegar and seasoned with spices, cooked down until it clings.
- [Lexington dip](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/sauce/lexington-dip/): The Piedmont's sauce: the east's vinegar, salt, pepper and red pepper with ketchup or tomato and water added, sometimes sugar, so that it comes out thin and reddish — tangy, a little sweet or hot by the house, and every…
- [light tomato sauce](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/sauce/light-tomato-sauce/): Vinegar-and-pepper sauce with ketchup added — enough to redden and sweeten it a little, not enough to thicken it — and often cayenne or a bottled hot sauce.
- [Maurice's Southern Gold](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/sauce/maurices-southern-gold/): The mustard sauce of Maurice's Piggie Park at West Columbia, sold in bottles, half gallons and gallons alongside the family's Hickory Red, Vinegar and Hot Pepper sauces.
- [Melvin's Golden Sauce](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/sauce/melvins-golden-sauce/): The mustard sauce of Melvin's Bar-B-Que in Charleston, sold in 16-ounce glass bottles, half gallons and gallons, beside the house's Southern Red, Sweet Red and Vinegar sauces.
- [mustard-based barbecue sauce](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/sauce/mustard-sauce/): Prepared yellow mustard thinned with vinegar and sweetened with sugar or brown sugar, with black and red pepper and whatever else the house keeps to itself — Bessinger's bottled version listed mustard, brown sugar, soy…
- [Sam Jones BBQ sauce](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/sauce/sam-jones-sauce/): A bottled line from the whole-hog house Sam Jones opened at Winterville in 2015, third generation of the Skylight Inn family at Ayden.
- [Scott's Barbecue Sauce](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/sauce/scotts-barbecue-sauce/): A bottled eastern North Carolina sauce — vinegar-based, the recipe kept secret, sold as sugar-free and fat-free — made by the Scott family of Goldsboro since the mid-1940s from a recipe the Rev.
- [Texas Pete](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/sauce/texas-pete/): A cayenne-pepper hot sauce made by the T.W. Garner Food Company of Winston-Salem, North Carolina, since 1929 — mild as hot sauces go, 747 on the Scoville scale — in a flip-top bottle with a red cowboy on a…
- [vinegar-and-pepper sauce](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/sauce/vinegar-pepper-sauce/): Vinegar — cider or white — with salt, black pepper and crushed red pepper, and nothing else in its plainest form; some houses add sugar, a bottled hot sauce or lemon.
- [Wells Hog Heaven Barbecue Sauce](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/sauce/wells-hog-heaven/): A vinegar-based sauce made at Burgaw, the seat of Pender County in southeastern North Carolina, and sold in that corner of the state.

## Dishes
- [baked beans](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/baked-beans/): White beans — navy or pea beans — cooked slow in a sweet brown sauce of molasses or brown sugar with pork in it, and served hot in a cup or a compartment of the tray.
- [banana pudding](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/banana-pudding/): Layers of sweet vanilla custard, vanilla wafers and sliced bananas built up in a dish and topped with meringue or whipped cream, then chilled until the wafers soften and the layers run together.
- [barbecue chicken](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/barbecue-chicken/): Half a chicken, cooked on the pit beside the pig or on its own cooker until the skin chars, brushed with the house sauce — vinegar and pepper in the east, a thin tomato-and-vinegar dip in the Piedmont — and sold by the…
- [barbecue sandwich](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/barbecue-sandwich/): Chopped pork on a soft white bun with slaw laid on the meat. In North Carolina it is the commonest form of the sandwich: whole-hog barbecue dressed with vinegar and pepper in the east, chopped or sliced shoulder with…
- [barbecue tray](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/barbecue-tray/): The unit of ordering at a Carolina barbecue counter: a paper boat or a plate with the chopped pork on one side and slaw on the other, and no bun.
- [Blenheim Ginger Ale](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/blenheim-ginger-ale/): A ginger ale bottled at Hamer, in Dillon County, South Carolina, made with Jamaica ginger and sugar in mineral water from a spring in Marlboro County, and hot enough that the heat is the point of it.
- [boiled potatoes](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/boiled-potatoes/): Potatoes boiled whole or in halves until they are soft and served beside chopped whole hog on the eastern North Carolina plate — the side the Piedmont does not have.
- [Brunswick stew](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/brunswick-stew/): A thick tomato stew of chicken or pork with corn, butter beans (lima beans), onion and, in the east, potatoes, cooked in big pots and served in a cup beside the barbecue.
- [Cheerwine](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/cheerwine/): A cherry-flavoured soft drink — burgundy-red, sweet, with a strong black-cherry note and more carbonation than most sodas — made in Salisbury, Rowan County, North Carolina by the Carolina Beverage Corporation since…
- [chicken bog](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/chicken-bog/): Chicken, rice and smoked sausage cooked together in the chicken's own broth until the rice has taken up the liquid and sits wet and plump — a pilau (rice cooked in stock) that is deliberately wetter than a pilau.
- [collards](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/collards/): Broad flat leaves of a loose-headed cabbage, stripped from the stem, cut in ribbons and stewed a long time with a piece of smoked pork until they are dark and soft, in a salty broth the South calls pot liquor.
- [cornbread](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/cornbread/): A quick bread of cornmeal — meal, water or buttermilk, salt, fat, often egg and soda — baked in a pan, a skillet or a stick mould. It comes with eastern North Carolina barbecue in two forms.
- [Duke's mayonnaise](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/dukes-mayonnaise/): A bottled mayonnaise made in Mauldin, South Carolina, outside Greenville: egg yolks, oil and cider vinegar, with more yolk than most brands and no added sugar, which is where the tang comes from that the company sells…
- [fried okra](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/fried-okra/): Okra pods sliced into rounds, rolled in cornmeal and fried until the outside is crisp.
- [green beans](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/green-beans/): Whole or broken pods of the common bean, stewed slow with a piece of pork until they give up their squeak and take on the meat's salt, and served in a cup or a compartment beside the barbecue.
- [hash and rice](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/hash-and-rice/): A thick stew, or gravy, of pork cooked down with onions until it can be eaten with a spoon, ladled over white rice beside the barbecue.
- [hushpuppies](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/hushpuppies/): Balls or fingers of cornmeal batter — meal, a little flour, egg, buttermilk or water, salt, soda, often onion — dropped by the spoonful into hot oil and fried until the outside is crisp and dark gold and the inside soft…
- [mac and cheese](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/mac-and-cheese/): Macaroni in a cheese sauce, most often cheddar, baked in a dish until the top browns.
- [outside brown](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/outside-brown/): The dark crust from the outside of a pork shoulder — the bark, where ten hours of smoke and dip have cooked into the surface — ordered by name at Lexington pits.
- [peach cobbler](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/peach-cobbler/): Sliced peaches sweetened and thickened in a deep dish and covered with a crust — pastry, biscuit dough or a batter — then baked until the top browns and the fruit bubbles at the edge.
- [pickles](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/pickles/): Cucumbers held in brine or vinegar until they sour, sliced into rounds or spears and put on the plate beside the meat, with the sandwich, or loose in a dish on the table.
- [pig pickin' cake](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/pig-pickin-cake/): A layer cake of convenience-food parts: yellow or butter-golden cake mix beaten with eggs, oil and a can of mandarin oranges, juice and all, baked in three eight-inch pans and frosted with a can of crushed pineapple…
- [pork skins](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/pork-skins/): The pig's hide, cooked until it blisters and cracks. On an eastern whole hog the skin faces up through the night and is turned to the coals at the end to crisp; at Skylight Inn it is chopped into the meat, where the…
- [potato salad](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/potato-salad/): Boiled potatoes cut up cold and dressed with mayonnaise, with hard-boiled egg, onion, celery, sweet pickle or relish and often a spoon of yellow mustard that colours the whole bowl.
- [red slaw](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/red-slaw/): Finely chopped green cabbage dressed with vinegar, ketchup, sugar, salt and black pepper — or with the pit's own dip — and no mayonnaise.
- [sweet tea](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/sweet-tea/): Black tea brewed strong, sweetened with sugar while hot — so it dissolves, rather than being stirred into a cold glass — and poured over ice.
- [white slaw](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/dish/white-slaw/): Finely chopped cabbage in a dressing of mayonnaise or whipped salad dressing, sweet and pale: the slaw of eastern North Carolina and of most of South Carolina.

## Pit
- [block pit](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/pit/block-pit/): An open pit built above ground of cinder blocks — concrete blocks — wide and shallow, a little longer than a split hog, with a rack across the top on which the pig lies and a bed of charcoal below; brick or steel are…
- [brick pit](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/pit/brick-pit/): The masonry pit of the Piedmont: a closed brick chamber with a rack for the shoulders and a chimney through the roof to carry off the smoke.
- [burn barrel](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/pit/burn-barrel/): A repurposed steel drum — or, at Scott's in Hemingway, two 55-gallon drums welded together — in which logs are burned down to coals: the wood goes in at the top, the coals are pulled out from below and carried by shovel…
- [chopping block](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/pit/chopping-block/): A thick wooden block and a pair of cleavers, on which cooked pork is turned into barbecue.
- [direct heat](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/pit/direct-heat/): The Carolina way of putting fire to meat: a bed of hardwood coals directly beneath the hog or the shoulders, with no flame and no separate firebox.
- [gas and electric cookers](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/pit/gas-and-electric-cookers/): The cookers most Carolina barbecue is cooked in: steel ovens fired by propane, natural gas or an electric element, with a thermostat and racks, and often a box for wood chips or a log to put smoke on the meat.
- [hickory and oak](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/pit/hickory-and-oak/): The hardwoods of the Carolina pit. Hickory and oak are the woods a Carolina cook burns, usually together and usually burned down to coals before they go under the meat: Lexington pits cook over oak and hickory coals…
- [hog killing](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/pit/hog-killing/): The winter slaughter of the farm's hogs, done on the first cold day of autumn or winter, when the meat would keep.
- [pig cooker](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/pit/pig-cooker/): A steel box on a trailer chassis, long enough for a split hog, with a hinged lid, a grate, and either a row of propane burners underneath or a bed for charcoal: the cooker of the pig pickin', towed to the church lot…
- [pork shoulder](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/pit/pork-shoulder/): The front leg and shoulder of the pig, sold as one primal — a primal being one of the large first divisions of a carcass — or split in two: the butt, the upper half with the blade bone, and the picnic, the lower arm…
- [whole hog](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/pit/whole-hog/): The entire dressed pig — dressed meaning gutted and scraped of hair, the head sometimes left on — split open along the backbone, laid flat over coals and cooked as one piece, then pulled from the bones and chopped…

## Places
- [12 Bones Smokehouse](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/12-bones-smokehouse/): A mountain barbecue house now trading from Hendersonville Road in Arden, south of Asheville, after Hurricane Helene took its River Arts District room in September 2024.
- [Allen & Son Barbeque](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/allen-and-son/): The hickory-fired pork-shoulder restaurant on Millhouse Road at N.C. 86 north of Chapel Hill that Keith Allen opened in 1971 at nineteen and closed in the first week of December 2018, quietly, to avoid a long goodbye.
- [Alston Bridges Barbecue](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/alston-bridges-barbecue/): The Shelby pork-shoulder house of the other Bridges family, on East Grover Street in Cleveland County, where Alston Bridges and his wife Mabel bought the property in 1955.
- [B's Barbecue](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/bs-barbecue/): A whole-hog and chicken pit on the edge of Greenville, Pitt County, in a converted country store on a road the county named for it.
- [Backyard BBQ Pit](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/backyard-bbq-pit/): A Black-owned barbecue restaurant on N.C. 55, the Apex Highway, in southeast Durham, opened in April 2007 by Fabianne and Melvin Simmons, who bought a struggling restaurant and made it a neighborhood institution…
- [Bar-B-Q Center](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/bar-b-q-center/): A pork-shoulder pit and ice-cream counter on North Main Street in Lexington, Davidson County, that began in 1955 as a dairy bar, put a shoulder on a pit one slow winter, and has been the Conrad family's since: Sonny…
- [Bessinger's Bar-B-Q](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/bessingers-bar-b-q/): A Bessinger family barbecue house at 1602 Savannah Highway in Charleston's West Ashley.
- [Big T Bar-B-Q](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/big-t-bar-b-q/): A Black-owned wood-burning pit on Congaree Road at Gadsden, in lower Richland County below Columbia, run by Larry Brown, known as Teddy and as Big T, who has sold barbecue to the Columbia area for more than thirty…
- [Bobbee O's BBQ](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/bobbee-os-bbq/): A Black-owned barbecue counter on Statesville Road in north Charlotte, opened in 2008 by Bob Steven Roberts after four years working on his sauce.
- [Bobby's BBQ](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/bobbys-bbq/): A Texas-leaning smokehouse on North Main Street in Fountain Inn, Greenville County, owned by Octavius Nelson, called Tay, and his wife Sarah.
- [Brown's Bar-B-Que](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/browns-bar-b-que/): A farm family's buffet house on the Williamsburg County Highway north of Kingstree, in the Pee Dee, opened in 1981 as a take-out window by Thomas M.
- [Bum's Restaurant](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/bums-restaurant/): A wood-fired whole-hog restaurant in downtown Ayden, Pitt County, opened in 1963 by Latham 'Bum' Dennis, of the family that counts Skilton Dennis's 1830 wagon as the start of barbecue for sale here, and run by his son…
- [Buxton Hall Barbecue](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/buxton-hall-barbecue/): A whole-hog restaurant that ran from August 2015 to November 22, 2023 in a 1930s roller rink on Banks Avenue in Asheville's South Slope, opened by pitmaster Elliott Moss with Meherwan Irani's Chai Pani restaurant group.
- [Cannon's BBQ](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/cannons-bbq/): A small barbecue house in a converted mobile home at a five-way crossroads in Little Mountain, Newberry County — the Dutch Fork, the German-settled land between the Broad and Saluda rivers where the Midlands mustard…
- [Carolina Bar-B-Que](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/carolina-bar-b-que/): A mustard-sauce buffet house on South Main Street in New Ellenton, Aiken County, founded by Willie Mae Walker and her son Jess.
- [Clyde Cooper's BBQ](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/clyde-coopers/): Raleigh's downtown barbecue house since New Year's Day 1938, when Clyde Cooper opened on East Davie Street with fifty dollars borrowed from a brother-in-law; it moved around the corner to 327 South Wilmington Street in…
- [Cook's Barbecue](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/cooks-barbecue/): A pork-shoulder pit off Valiant Drive south of Lexington, Davidson County, built by hand in 1969 by Doug Cook on a cul-de-sac plot down the road from his house — a pit and kitchen, a wooden chopping block, a drive-up…
- [Cooper's Country Store](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/coopers-country-store/): A whitewashed general store on US 521 near Salters, south of Kingstree in Williamsburg County, that sells hardware, groceries, gasoline, diesel, propane, plow points, cast-iron cookware, live crickets — and, from a…
- [Dukes Bar-B-Que](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/dukes-bar-b-que/): The name on a dozen or more buffet houses across the Midlands and Lowcountry, all descended from the sons of Manuel Dukes of Orangeburg County, who learned pit cooking from a Rowesville pitmaster and catered the…
- [Fuzzy's Bar-B-Q](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/fuzzys-bar-b-q/): A pork-shoulder house on Highway Street in Madison, Rockingham County, opened in 1954 by T.H. 'Fuzzy' Nelson and in the Nelson family since.
- [Grady's Barbecue](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/gradys-barbecue/): A whole-hog pit at a country crossroads in Dudley, Wayne County, south of Goldsboro, opened on July 4, 1986 by Steve and Gerri Grady and run by Gerri and their son Scottie since Steve's death in August 2025.
- [Henry's Smokehouse](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/henrys-smokehouse/): An Upstate barbecue house at 240 Wade Hampton Boulevard on the edge of downtown Greenville, opened by Beau Hammond — in 1991 by the company's own account, in 1992 by the Greenville Journal's — in a small building that…
- [Hite's Bar-B-Que](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/hites-bar-b-q/): A take-out barbecue stand on Dreher Road in West Columbia, open only on Friday and Saturday, where the Hite family has cooked whole hogs and hams over oak and hickory coals since 1957.
- [Home Team BBQ](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/home-team-bbq/): A Charleston barbecue company that began in November 2006 when Aaron Siegel, a Culinary Institute-trained cook from Atlanta, turned Bunch's, a mid-century gas station at 1205 Ashley River Road in West Ashley, into Fiery…
- [Hursey's Bar-B-Q](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/hurseys-bar-b-q/): The Burlington, Alamance County, barbecue business of the Hursey family: Sylvester and Daisy Hursey began smoking pork over a backyard pit in 1945 with a sauce of their own, moved to a cafe in Gibsonville with two big…
- [Jack Cobb & Son Barbecue Place](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/jack-cobb-and-son/): A Black-owned whole-hog counter on South Main Street in Farmville, Pitt County, that Jack Cobb and his son Rudy built as a cinder-block storefront in 1971 and closed in the autumn of 2018.
- [Jackie Hite's Bar-B-Q](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/jackie-hites-bar-b-q/): A whole-hog buffet house on East Railroad Avenue in Leesville, across the tracks from the town, that James Lee 'Jackie' Hite opened in May 1979 and ran until his death in September 2016; his family closed it in 2018.
- [Keaton's Barbecue](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/keatons-barbecue/): A chicken house in the crossroads community of Cleveland, Rowan County, west of Salisbury, where since 1953 the chicken has been fried (or baked) and then dipped whole in a hot vinegar-and-tomato barbecue sauce …
- [Kepley's Bar-B-Q](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/kepleys-barbecue/): A High Point, Guilford County, barbecue stand in a surplus World War II Quonset hut — a half-cylinder of corrugated steel — opened in June 1948 by Hayden Kepley on North Main Street and closed on February 8, 2025 after…
- [Lewis Barbecue](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/lewis-barbecue/): A Central Texas-style barbecue restaurant at 464 North Nassau Street on the upper peninsula of Charleston, opened in June 2016 by John Lewis, a pitmaster from El Paso who cooked in Austin with Franklin Barbecue and then…
- [Lexington Barbecue](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/lexington-barbecue/): The pork-shoulder pit on Smokehouse Lane in Lexington, Davidson County, that Wayne Monk opened in 1962 at 26 after working under Warner Stamey, and that he owns with his son Rick.
- [Luella's Bar-B-Que](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/place/luellas-bar-b-que/): An Asheville barbecue house on Merrimon Avenue with a second room at Biltmore Park, opened in 2007 by Jeff Miller and named for his grandmother and his daughter. Jeff and Ashley Miller own it.

## Organizations
- [Campaign for Real Barbecue](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/org/campaign-for-real-barbecue/): A campaign, founded in 2013 by the sociologist and barbecue writer John Shelton Reed and the blogger Dan Levine, that certifies restaurants which cook the barbecue style traditional to their area and rely solely on wood…
- [North Carolina Barbecue Society](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/org/north-carolina-barbecue-society/): A non-profit founded in 2006 in Winston-Salem by Jim Early, a lawyer and cook, to promote North Carolina's barbecue culture and, in its own words, to secure the state's place as the Barbecue Capital of the World.
- [South Carolina Barbeque Association](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/org/south-carolina-barbeque-association/): A judging body and booster founded in 2004 by Lake E. High Jr., a wine judge, and Walter Rolandi, a psychologist, 'to train the best BBQ judges in the world and to preserve and promote the unique nature of South…
- [Southern Foodways Alliance](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/org/southern-foodways-alliance/): An institute of the Center for the Study of Southern Culture at the University of Mississippi, founded in 1999 and directed since then by John T.

## Events
- [fundraiser barbecue](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/event/fundraiser-barbecue/): The plate sale: a church, a volunteer fire department, a Ruritan club or a scout troop cooks pork — a whole hog or a stack of butts — and sells it by the plate on a Saturday to pay for a roof, a truck or a mission.
- [Hillsborough Hog Day](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/event/hillsborough-hog-day/): A two-day barbecue festival and cook-off at River Park in downtown Hillsborough, Orange County, held since 1983 — the oldest continuing barbecue festival in North Carolina, by the Daily Tar Heel's account — and run…
- [Lexington Barbecue Festival](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/event/lexington-barbecue-festival/): A one-day street festival on Main Street in uptown Lexington, Davidson County, each October since 1984, built on the town's pork-shoulder barbecue: up to twenty area restaurants cook and sell, several blocks close to…
- [Mallard Creek Barbecue](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/event/mallard-creek-barbecue/): The one-day church barbecue of Mallard Creek Presbyterian Church in northeast Charlotte, held on the fourth Thursday of October from 1929 to 2024 and retired in 2025 after ninety-three editions.
- [pig pickin'](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/event/pig-pickin/): A party at which a whole hog is cooked for the crowd and the crowd eats it off the pig — picked by hand from the split carcass, or chopped on a block beside it.
- [political barbecue](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/event/political-barbecue/): The free feed a candidate or a party puts on to draw a crowd: a whole hog, or these days a pile of pork butts, cooked for whoever comes, with speeches or a rope line attached.
- [South Carolina Festival of Discovery](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/event/festival-of-discovery/): A three-day barbecue-and-blues festival in Uptown Greenwood each July — Thursday to Saturday of the second weekend; July 9 to 11 in 2026 — hosted by the Uptown Greenwood Development Corporation.

## Words
- [barbecue](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/word/barbecue/): The cooked meat itself — in the Carolinas, pork cooked slowly over coals or in a cooker and then chopped, pulled or sliced — and, by extension, the place that sells it and the gathering that eats it.
- [Carolina Gold](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/word/carolina-gold/): Two South Carolina things with one name. The sauce: the yellow-mustard barbecue sauce of the Midlands — mustard, vinegar, sugar and spices — which Wikipedia says is sometimes called Carolina Gold and which Maurice…
- [chopped](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/word/chopped/): The way most Carolina barbecue reaches the tray: cooked meat cut across on a block with cleavers — in the east fine enough to hold the thin vinegar sauce, in the Piedmont in larger pieces.
- [dip](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/word/dip/): The Lexington word for its sauce: vinegar, water, ketchup or tomato, salt, black and red pepper, sugar to taste — thin enough to pour, reddish rather than red.
- [Down East](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/word/down-east/): In North Carolina, the coastal plain east of Raleigh — the barbecue east, where the hog is cooked whole and the sauce has no tomato; eastern North Carolina barbecue is also called Down East barbecue.
- [Dutch Fork](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/word/dutch-fork/): The land between the Saluda and the Broad rivers above their meeting at Columbia, in Lexington, Newberry and Richland counties, settled by German-speaking Protestants in the middle of the eighteenth century and named…
- [fixins](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/word/fixins/): The sides and trimmings that come with the meat: slaw, hushpuppies or cornbread, boiled potatoes in the east, hash and rice in South Carolina, pickles, sweet tea.
- [hog](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/word/hog/): In Carolina barbecue speech the animal is a hog. Whole hog is the eastern North Carolina and Pee Dee style; a hog killing is the winter work of the farm; a hog's size is its dressed weight.
- [light bread](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/word/light-bread/): The Southern name for white yeast bread — a store loaf or a soft bun — as against cornbread, biscuits and pone, a dense cornmeal cake.
- [Pee Dee](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/word/pee-dee/): The river and the region. The Pee Dee rises in the North Carolina mountains as the Yadkin, takes the name Pee Dee below the mouth of the Uwharrie, crosses into South Carolina and reaches the sea at Winyah Bay.
- [Piedmont](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/word/piedmont/): The plateau between the coastal plain and the Blue Ridge, from New York to Alabama and nearly 300 miles wide in North Carolina; its eastern edge is the fall line, where rivers drop off hard rock onto the soft plain and…
- [pit](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/word/pit/): The place the cooking happens. First a trench in the ground filled with hardwood coals, the split hog on a rack above; then a wide, shallow container of cinder block, brick or steel above ground, still a pit; then, at…
- [pitmaster](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/word/pitmaster/): The person who runs the pit — the fire, the coals, the turning of the hog, the call that it is done. A recent word for an old job.
- [pulled pork](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/word/pulled-pork/): Pork cooked slowly over coals or in a cooker until it comes off the bone in strands, then taken apart by hand or with forks rather than cut.
- [slaw](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/word/slaw/): Shredded raw cabbage, dressed and served cold, on every Carolina barbecue tray and most sandwiches.

## Art
- [barbecue postcards](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/art/barbecue-postcards/): Between about 1930 and 1945 an American restaurant could order its own postcards by the thousand.
- [Going the whole hog — the 1830s barbecue lithographs](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/art/political-barbecue-prints/): A small group of American political prints from the 1830s in which the barbecue is the joke and the pig is the politician.
- [Pigs in the City](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/art/pigs-in-the-city/): Life-sized pig sculptures, painted by artists and set out on the sidewalks of Lexington, Davidson County. Uptown Lexington, Inc.
- [roadside barbecue signs](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/art/roadside-barbecue-signs/): The sign a barbecue place puts at the road: a steel pylon with a lit box on top, neon or bulbs picking out a name, a bottler's disc above it, and a changeable letterboard underneath for the day's news.
- [The FSA photographs of Carolina eating](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/art/fsa-barbecue-photographs/): The Farm Security Administration — a New Deal agency for rural poverty — kept photographers on the road from 1935, and their negatives went to the Library of Congress as federal work, free of copyright.
- [the pig mascot](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/art/pig-mascot/): One pig, drawn once, used everywhere a barbecue business puts its name: the sign, the menu, the sauce label, the takeout box, the trailer door, the roofline, the weather vane.
- [the pig that serves itself](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/art/cannibal-pig-sign/): A barbecue sign on which the pig is not the meat but the staff: a pig in a chef's toque carrying a covered tray, a pig in an apron at a pit, a pig in sunglasses eating a pork sandwich, a pig holding the restaurant's own…

## Stories
- [How to order](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/story/how-to-order/): At a Carolina barbecue counter the words are short and they mean particular things. Barbecue is the meat, not the event. A tray has no bread; a plate does.
- [The Great Divide](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/story/the-great-divide/): North Carolina cooks barbecue two ways and has never agreed to disagree about it. East of Raleigh the whole hog goes on the pit and the sauce is vinegar, salt and pepper with no tomato in it.
- [The Sunday question](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/story/the-sunday-question/): Sunday is the day a Carolina barbecue house is most likely to be shut, and the day some people will tell you not to order barbecue anyway. Neither is about the meat being worse on a Sunday.
- [Where all of this came from](https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/story/free-to-use/): Everything on this site is built from things anyone can open: public-domain cookbooks, openly licensed encyclopaedias and photographs, open map data, oral histories published by the people who recorded them, and the…

- [Pinot Country](https://nanobotco.github.io/pinot-noir/): pinot noir: the vine, the regions, the cellars
- [Care Abroad](https://nanobotco.github.io/care-abroad/): treatment across borders, with published prices and their dates
- [Thai Roots](https://nanobotco.github.io/thairoots/): a root dictionary of Thai, with a word decomposer
- [The index](https://nanobotco.github.io/index/): every corpus, site and repository, counted
- [Uptake](https://nanobotco.github.io/uptake/): a field manual on publishing for machines that copy
- [NaNoBotCo](https://nanobotco.github.io/): the portal
- [Ask Mot Dang](https://ask.motdang.net/): reader assistant over the directory
- [ai.motdang.net](https://ai.motdang.net/): white-label assistants, by seat
- [Defiant](https://defiant.to/): medical and dental care in Chiang Mai, with a translator at the appointment
- [Hongdam](https://hongdam.net/): bilingual web development, Chiang Rai
- [ฮักฝรั่ง](https://hakfarang.net/): เรื่องเงิน วีซ่า และชีวิตกับแฟนฝรั่ง
- [Offrampt](https://offrampt.net/): turning crypto into spendable local money, Thailand first
